audit_kind: s3b composer batch A remediation + B1, ur (RTL), fresh independent audit of the final uncommitted bytes on disk

auditor.actual_model_source: session header anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5; no provider fallback observed

method.icu: every en and ur value of the ten namespaces parsed with @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser (requiresOtherClause); argument names/types, number skeletons, select option sets compared per key: 0 differences; ur plural categories one/other only
method.render: intl-messageformat locale ur at counts 0,1,2,5,11,21,100 for arg.removal_many, interrupt.stopped_children/jobs/both, summary.records_unpriced, ask_queue rail.open/close; fast_mode.dial_differs on all 4 pairs; every duration form (d/h/m/s, 1 and many, unknown) through expiry.in, deadline.with_subject, response.timed_out; owner_fallback phrase and a real device name through every {owner} key; effort/spend/device_move/aside splices with realistic arguments
method.hygiene: NFC, no edge/double space, no non-ASCII whitespace or bidi/zero-width controls in any ICU header or value, no Arabic-only yeh/kaf/teh-marbuta, no Devanagari, no non-Latin digits, no ASCII . ? , ; after Urdu, technical tokens (/stop /btw /effort Enter Esc local-operator API Local Operator Canvas ${name}) verbatim, ::group-off absent from this slice
method.bidi: fribidi --rtl --nopad --nobreak --clean over the rendered values with Latin tokens, sigils or caps; findings are code-side MINORs because the repo gate forbids U+200E/U+2066-2069 in ur values
method.glossary: each term grepped across the 8093 shipped ur values outside these ten namespaces; checked against ~/local-operator/i18n/glossary.md and style-guides/ur.md
method.gates: node --test scripts/i18n/locale-parity.test.mjs 44/44 pass (0 fail; the coder already added the IDENTICAL_OK entries); node scripts/i18n/context-parity.mjs ok; node --test scripts/i18n/ur-activation.test.mjs 3/3 pass

findings.proposed: text unchanged; isolate in code (renderer step for dir=rtl: LRM before a / or $ that precedes a Latin letter or {)
findings.reason: A literal / or $ that opens the string or follows Urdu paints after the word under dir=rtl (fribidi --rtl: "model/"); repo gate forbids U+200E in ur values, so not fixable in the bytes.

findings.proposed: text unchanged; wrap the argument value in U+2068..U+2069 at the call site
findings.reason: Unisolated values carrying a sigil, bracket or symbol paint reversed after Urdu ("<move <path/", "J⌘"); FSI/PDI at the call site fixes it.

findings.current: نئی چیٹ میں /{name} کوئی آرگیومنٹ نہیں لیتی۔ پہلے پیغام کے لیے اسے مقرر کرنے کے لیے صرف /{name} لکھیں۔
findings.proposed: نئی چیٹ میں /{name} کوئی آرگیومنٹ نہیں لیتی۔ پہلے پیغام کے لیے اسے مقرر کرنا ہو تو صرف /{name} لکھیں۔
findings.reason: Applying prior UR-N1 (کو -> کے لیے) left two consecutive "کے لیے" in one clause ("پہلے پیغام کے لیے اسے مقرر کرنے کے لیے"), which stutters; the conditional form reads natively and keeps the meaning.

findings.current: ... یا سیشن ختم کرنے کے لیے /stop استعمال کریں۔
findings.reason: /stop follows Urdu so it paints "stop/" under dir=rtl; same class as UR-1.

findings.current: ... ابھی مقرر کرنے کے لیے {command} چلائیں۔  with {command}="/effort <level>"
findings.proposed: text unchanged; wrap {command} in U+2068..U+2069 at the call site
findings.reason: fribidi --rtl paints the value as "<effort <level/"; FSI/PDI around the value fixes it (same class as UR-2).

findings.current: {time} میں میعاد ختم ہو گی  (with duration "5 گھنٹے": 27 chars vs English "expires in 5h", 13)
findings.proposed: keep; if the rendered chip truncates use "{time} میں ختم" for expiry.in
findings.reason: Urdu has no one-letter unit abbreviations, so the chip text is about twice the English width; the sidecar asks for compact units, so flag for a rendered narrow-chip check. Grammar is correct: the duration is always in the oblique before میں/بعد ("1 گھنٹے میں").

findings.proposed: text unchanged; wrap {cap} in U+2068..U+2069 at the call site
findings.reason: fribidi --rtl paints "(⌘J)" as "(J⌘)"; Ctrl+J is unaffected.
"قریبی" reads as "nearest/nearby"; "soonest" here means the one that expires first.
